def conv(x, w, pad=0):
    xp = np.pad(f(x), ((0, 0), (0, 0), (pad, pad), (pad, pad)))
    p = sliding_window_view(xp, w.shape[2:], axis=(2, 3))
    return np.einsum("bchwij,ocij->bohw", p, f(w))


def softmax(a):
    a = f(a)
    e = np.exp(a - a.max(-1, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(-1, keepdims=True)
